{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined wool-blend coat, tailored straight cut with a midi length reaching mid-calf, slate blue color (#4B5D6B), heavy wool fabric.
A chunky cable-knit turtleneck sweater, relaxed fit, charcoal gray color (#36454F), soft merino wool fabric.
Dark wash wide-leg trousers, straight leg cut with a full length to the ankle, black color (#000000), stretch cotton twill fabric.
Leather combat boots, heavy chunky sole design with an ankle height, forest green color (#225538), smooth leather and rubber sole materials.

This outfit is perfect for a chilly autumn city walk as it provides essential warmth while maintaining a polished everyday look. The layered approach with the coat over the cozy knit ensures comfort against the cold without sacrificing style. The dark neutral palette creates a sophisticated visual contrast that feels grounded and practical for navigating urban streets in daylight."}
